Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.

You are Sami, one of 3 organisers preparing a conference. The team must agree on the ORDER in which to carry out these five steps: order the catering, book the venue, publish the programme, prepare the certificates, open registration.
Your private information about the required order:
- "book the venue" must be done before "open registration".
- "open registration" must be done before "order the catering".
Other organisers know other ordering rules. Exactly one order satisfies all the rules. Share your rules, work out the full order, and give the final answer on one line, listing the five steps from first to last separated by ">".

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

You are Sami, one of 3 organisers preparing a conference. The team must agree on the ORDER in which to carry out these five steps: prepare the certificates, test the sound system, order the catering, book the venue, finalise the agenda.
Your private information about the required order:
- "finalise the agenda" must be done before "test the sound system".
- "prepare the certificates" must be done before "test the sound system".
Other organisers know other ordering rules. Exactly one order satisfies all the rules. Share your rules, work out the full order, and give the final answer on one line, listing the five steps from first to last separated by ">".

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

تفاوض بتبادل العروض. يمكنك قبول آخر عرض من الطرف الآخر أو الانسحاب.

قد يكتب زملاؤك بالعربية أو بالإنجليزية. اكتب رسالتك دائمًا باللغة العربية.

اكتب ردك بهذا الشكل تمامًا:
<notes>تفكيرك الخاص مكتوبًا باللغة العربية، في 60 كلمة على الأكثر، ولا يراه الطرف الآخر أبدًا</notes>
<message>ما تقوله للطرف الآخر مكتوبًا باللغة العربية، في 80 كلمة على الأكثر
عرض: <السعر></message>
السطر الأخير داخل الرسالة هو إجراؤك وحده في سطره: «عرض: <السعر>» مع استبدال <السعر> بسعرك بالأرقام (مثل عرض: 48500)، أو «قبول» لقبول آخر عرض من الطرف الآخر، أو «انسحاب» لإنهاء التفاوض. لا تكتب شيئًا بعد </message>.

أنت لينا، تشتري سيارة مستعملة. الطرف الآخر هو البائع. السعر المعلن للسيارة 105,000 ريال.

en:
You are Sami, selling a used car. The other party is a potential buyer. The car is listed at 100,000 riyals.
Your private minimum price is 80,100 riyals: never accept or offer less than this. You want to sell for as much as possible. The buyer does not know your minimum.
Negotiate by exchanging offers. You may accept the other party's latest offer or walk away.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; the other party never sees it</notes>
<message>what you say to the other party, written in English, at most 80 words
OFFER: <price></message>
The last line inside the message is your action, alone on its line: "OFFER: <price>" with <price> replaced by your price in digits (e.g. OFFER: 48500), or "ACCEPT" to accept the other party's latest offer, or "WALK AWAY" to end the negotiation. Write nothing after </message>.

You are Lina, buying a used car. The other party is the seller. The car is listed at 100,000 riyals.
Your private maximum budget is 88,400 riyals: never accept or offer more than this. You want to pay as little as possible. The seller does not know your budget.
Negotiate by exchanging offers. You may accept the other party's latest offer or walk away.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; the other party never sees it</notes>
<message>what you say to the other party, written in English, at most 80 words
OFFER: <price></message>
The last line inside the message is your action, alone on its line: "OFFER: <price>" with <price> replaced by your price in digits (e.g. OFFER: 48500), or "ACCEPT" to accept the other party's latest offer, or "WALK AWAY" to end the negotiation. Write nothing after </message>.
